Our Story

More Than a Fragrance. A Feeling.

AURÉVÉ was born from the belief that fragrance is more than a scent. It is a memory, an emotion, and an invisible signature. Each creation captures the beauty of moments that deserve to last forever.

Our Philosophy

I

The Art of Perfumery

Rare ingredients, patient maceration and a perfumer’s steady hand shape each composition into something quietly extraordinary.

II

Crafted to Be Remembered

Every accord is built to linger, evolving from a luminous opening to a deep, resonant dry-down that stays with you.

III

Your Invisible Signature

The most intimate thing you wear. A scent that announces you before you speak and is recalled long after you leave.
